cost_today: About 6 hours a week across two people; one late order a month
if_nothing_changes: Holiday weeks keep slipping and the two largest accounts keep asking for a status call
trigger: Order email arrives from a wholesale customer (follow-up found: the customer's Friday forecast call sets the quantities two days earlier)
end_state: Order released to delivery and invoice sent

steps.name: Log the order

exceptions.what: Order arrives by phone instead of email

steps.wrong_looks_like: Order missing from the sheet on bake day

steps.name: Check stock against the order
steps.rule: If every item is in stock at the ordered quantity, confirm; otherwise escalate to the owner

exceptions.what: Stock count is stale because yesterday's bake was not entered

steps.cost_of_wrong: A confirmed order we cannot fill; the customer finds out on delivery day
steps.wrong_looks_like: Confirmation sent for an item with zero on hand

steps.name: Confirm date to the customer
steps.wrong_looks_like: Customer replies asking whether we got the order

steps.name: Schedule the bake and decide batch order
steps.cost_of_wrong: A late order; twice it has cost an account
steps.wrong_looks_like: Two orders finish after their delivery slot

steps.name: Bake and pack
steps.wrong_looks_like: Pack count does not match the order sheet

steps.name: Approve invoice and release
steps.rule: If pack count matches the confirmation and the price matches the customer's rate sheet, release

exceptions.what: Customer has an unpaid balance over 60 days

steps.cost_of_wrong: Unacceptable: an invoice we cannot collect, or shipping to an account on hold
steps.wrong_looks_like: Invoice total differs from the rate sheet

requirements.text: Delivered by 7am on the agreed date
Item count matches the confirmation email
Prices match the customer's rate sheet; sent the same day as delivery
Names each product, quantity, and delivery date
Entered before 6pm the day before the order is checked
One rate sheet per customer, dated within the last 12 months
